check_command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && bash scripts/scan_tracked.sh && uv run pytest -q

features.behavior: Ruff lint reports nothing on the whole tree.
Ruff format check passes on the whole tree.
The content scanner finds no personal-data or credential shapes in tracked files.

Every numeric or status claim in README, CHANGELOG and docs (test count, ADR count, threat count, eval figures, phase status) is listed in one registry with its source of truth and asserted by a test.
features.source: harness-history analysis 2026-10-15, item 1: README counts stale four times, 'eighteen threats' vs thirteen, 'Six ADRs'

features.behavior: Public docs and source comments contain no gate-finding ids, private workspace paths or third-person owner references; the denylist is shared with the existing public-docs test.
features.source: harness-history analysis item 2: WD-6, WD-8, W1, W15 each came back after a one-time scrub

features.behavior: Every client-writable field on a CLI or web entry point has a row in one table-driven test asserting it is tied to server-side state or revalidated; a new field fails until it has a row.
features.source: harness-history analysis item 3: extracted_json then paste_text, same shape one field over

features.behavior: CHANGELOG.md stays under a stated line budget and its header phase matches the project's current phase.
features.source: harness-history analysis item 4: compaction finding recurred five times after a written standing step

features.behavior: The scanner is tested against its own known false-positive shapes (hash runs, model ids, IP literals) and fails loudly when shell exit codes do not propagate.
features.source: harness-history analysis item 5: four false-positive patches, one local pass that CI failed

features.behavior: CI replays recorded eval responses and the published pass counts pin which case ids pass, not only how many.
features.source: harness-history analysis item 8: eval-gated gates nothing in CI; counts pinned but not membership

features.behavior: The scanner's model-id carve-out matches only a real model-id shape (claude-, a family, then version or date tokens); a phone-shaped digit run right after claude- is still flagged.
features.source: follow-up to scanner-self-test: the carve-out blanked anything after claude-

features.behavior: ingest --paste and --file refuse input over the fetcher's 5 MB ceiling with a usage error, writing nothing and making no model call.
features.source: trust-boundary-registry gap: stdin and file input had no size ceiling

features.behavior: Email detection is linear on long runs with no whitespace or @, and redaction output is byte-identical on existing inputs.
features.source: trust-boundary-registry finding: 160 KB single token took 46s in the sanitizer

features.behavior: scripts/scan_tracked.sh no longer excludes uv.lock, and the scanner passes it.
features.source: follow-up to scanner-self-test: uv.lock scans clean after the hash carve-out

features.behavior: CHANGELOG.md Phase B is a shape-and-lessons summary and the line budget is tightened to the new size.
features.source: follow-up to changelog-size-gate: Phase B was still about 110 lines

features.behavior: CI runs scripts/features.py check in the same job, and a test asserts the step is present.
features.source: harness follow-up: the feature list was only checked in the local pre-push hook
